notes.subject: מי אתי
notes.rationale: Rhetorical 'nĩ ũũ arĩ hamwe nakwa?' (as YLT/ASV) vs statement 'and there is none with me' (as KJV/JPS, reading ואפסי).

notes.subject: אתי
notes.rationale: אֵת 'with' (H854) occurs only here in Isaiah 44 — the prompt forces the ⟨את⟩ marker though the sense is the preposition 'with', not the object marker.

notes.subject: גאלך / ויצרך
notes.rationale: Paired participles 'redeemer-you / former-you' with matching suffixes; Gĩkũyũ keeps the pair but the suffix rhyme is lost.

translation: Nĩguo Yahwe oigĩte, mũcuki waku, ũrĩa akũrumbũiya kuuma tumbo-inĩ: Nĩĩwe Yahwe, ũrĩa woima indo ciothe, ũrĩa agatanaria ⟨את⟩ igũrũ o we mwekũrũ, na ũrĩa aracaria ⟨את⟩ thĩ — nĩ ũũ nĩ ũrĩa arĩ hamwe na ⟨את⟩ yakwa?

tokens.marks: hamwe na Yahwe — 'nĩ ũũ nĩ ũrĩa arĩ hamwe na yakwa?'
